verses.pali: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: “Someone with three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Akusalena kāyakammena, akusalena vacīkammena, akusalena manokammena—
verses.english: Unskillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ niraye.
verses.english: Someone with these three qualities is placed in hell as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge.
verses.english: Someone with three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.

verses.pali: Kusalena kāyakammena, kusalena vacīkammena, kusalena manokammena—
verses.english: Skillful deeds by way of body, speech, and mind.

verses.pali: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṁ nikkhitto evaṁ sagge”ti.
verses.english: Someone with these three qualities is placed in heaven as if delivered there.”
